subject: YC Application | Sandhika: Privacy-First Desktop Wellness for Linux
text:
Hello YC Team,

I'm Abhishek Singh, founder of Sandhika, a privacy-first desktop wellness application for Linux that helps users build healthier computer habits through intelligent reminders, fullscreen focus breaks, hydration tracking, and local-only data storage.

We've attached a one-page overview of the product and would appreciate any feedback.

Thank you for your time.

Best regards,
Abhishek Singh
Founder, Sandhika
